faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: All answers about the order process, payments, quality guarantees, and delivery are here.

delivery.question: How long does it take to prepare an order?
delivery.answer: Usually orders are prepared within 1–3 days depending on size and complexity. Large school and group orders are delivered within the agreed timeframe.

shipping.question: Is delivery available?
shipping.answer: Yes, delivery is available across Uzbekistan. In Tashkent by courier and to other regions through fast postal services or agreed taxi.

minimum.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
minimum.answer: There is no minimum order! You can even order a single ribbon. However, large group orders of 15 or more items receive special discounts.

custom.question: Can you create a custom design?
custom.answer: Absolutely! You can choose any text, school number, class letter, graduate name, fabric color, and lettering color.
